arabic text: DEKE SAR SHABBIR NE, ISLAAM ZINDAA KARDIYA
english translation text: By giving his head, Shabbir revived Islam.

arabic text: (KARBALA KO JISKE SAJDE) NE MU-ALLA KARDIYA
english translation text: His prostration raised Karbala to the highest honour.

arabic text: HASHR TAK KOI YAZIDI SAR UTHA SAKTA NAHI,\nJISKA BADLA ZINDAGI BHAR DEEN JUKAA SAKTA NAHI,\n(FATEMA KE LAAL NE) EHSAAN AISA KARDIYA
english translation text: Until the Resurrection, no follower of Yazid can raise his head;\nthis debt can never be repaid, even if faith bowed for a lifetime.\nFatima’s son bestowed such a favour upon the world.

arabic text: TERI QURBANI SE PEHLE DEEN KO AAYA NA CHAIN,\nAMBIYA SE BHI MUKAMMIL JO NAHO PAAYA HUSSEIN,\n(EK SAJDE NE TERE WOH) KAAM PURA KARDIYA
english translation text: Before your sacrifice, the faith had found no peace.\nWhat even the Prophets had not brought to completion, O Hussain,\nyour single prostration completed.

arabic text: AAJ BHI NAAGAAH WAFAAEN HAI TERE ABBAS PAR,\nNEHR PAR GHAZI KE DONO KAT GAYE BAAZU MAGAR,\n(TAA ABAD ISLAAM KE) PARCHAM KO UNCHA KARDIYA
english translation text: Even today, the river is ashamed before your Abbas.\nBoth Ghazi’s arms were severed at its bank,\nyet he raised Islam’s standard forever.

arabic text:
MAAR KAR IBNE ALI KO CHEENI ZAINAB KI RIDAA,
JAB PARHA KALMA NABI KAA PHIR SARE KARBOBALA,
(AALE EHMAD KE LIYE) YU(N) HASHR BARPAA
KARDIYA
english translation text:
They killed the son of Ali and snatched
Zainab’s veil, then recited the Prophet’s creed
upon the soil of Karbala. Thus they brought a
resurrection of grief upon the family of Ahmad.

arabic text: NAAZON SE NOKE SINAA PE UBHRAA THAA "JAWAAD"\nJO, KAISE BHULEGAA ZAMANA FATEMA KE CHAAND KO,\n(SAR KATAAKE USNE APNA) YU(N) UJAALA KARDIYA
english translation text: Jawad, the moon of Fatima rose with dignity upon the spear-point.\nHow could the world ever forget him?\nBy sacrificing his head, he filled the world with light.
